findings.title: Workflow can overwrite existing assets
findings.suggestedFix: Make the workflow manual-only and fail before an existing tag, release, or asset; remove --clobber.

findings.title: Publish authority is not bound to the exact operation
findings.suggestedFix: Bind the one-shot checkpoint to repository, candidate commit, tag, asset names/digests, and allowed actions.

findings.title: Partial uploads lack a safe continuation contract
findings.suggestedFix: Define readback-only recovery states and upload only a missing asset after its existing peer matches digest.

findings.title: Release-copy path is not implemented
findings.suggestedFix: Use the Tauri DMG path as the sole upload artifact or implement and verify a copy path.

summary: Independent review found four integration-authority and failure-recovery issues. The owner applied one consolidated spec-only fix before the required fresh closer.
